## Natural history notes

A medium-sized milkweed butterfly characterized by rich orange-brown wings with black veins, white-spotted black borders, and a darker body than the similar Monarch. In Florida, it is found in sunny open habitats such as prairies, fields, roadsides, pine flatwoods, gardens, pastures, and coastal areas where milkweeds and nectar plants are available. Adults feed on nectar from many flowers, while the caterpillars feed mainly on milkweeds and related plants, storing defensive chemicals that make them distasteful to many predators.
